texts.fr: M. de Lapradelle cite le dictum du juge Sir William Scott dans le cas Fox comme exemple de l'esprit de justice internationale qui doit animer les juges internationaux. texts.en: M. de Lapradelle quoted the dictum of Sir William Scott in the „Fox“ as an example of the spirit of international justice which ought to animate international judges. He thought that it would be inopportune to awake the national spirit in the judges by making of them the representatives of certain Powers.
